nodes.label: Analysis
nodes.question: How do companies practising green initiatives perceive the impact on their Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)?
nodes.answer: Companies that implement green practices report mixed experiences with their KPIs, with 15 out of 17 respondents agreeing that there are benefits, while a divided sample of 8 respondents disagree and 9 agree on the impact on KPIs.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Social|Decent work and economic growth|Sustainable enterprises|Green procurement practices_qna_001
nodes.label: Analysis
nodes.question: What is the trend in green raw material procurement among companies surveyed?
nodes.answer: Among the companies surveyed, 12 confirmed they engage in green supplier selection, with 7 stating they always purchase eco-friendly materials, 4 often, and only one sometimes, showing varying levels of commitment to green procurement practices.
